page.layout: One page of text, single column. Page number top right. Heading centred at top, then a short italic-style argument line, then verse lines in black letter with a paragraph per stanza, no margin notes.

main_text.head: Psalmus CXII.
main_text.p: Er lobt Gott von seiner allmächtigkeit.
Lobend ir diener deß Herrē/ lobend den namen deß Herren.
Gelobt sye der nam deß Herrē von yetz biß in die ewigkeit.
Von vfgang der Sonnen biß zů jrē nidergang ist hoch gelobt der nam deß Herren.
Vber alle völcker ist der Herr erhöcht/ vnd sin eer über die himel.
Wär ist wie d Herr vnser Gott/ der sin wonung so hoch hat/ vnd sich dennocht herab laßt zů besichtige was in himmel vnd vff erden ist:
Er erhebt den schlächtē vß de stoub vnd zücht den armen vß de kaat.
Das er in setze zů den Fürsten/ ja zů den Fürsten sines volcks.
Er macht die vnfruchtbaren fruchtbar/ vñ zů einer müter die mit kin den frôud hat.

page.notes: Heading "Psalmus CXII." is set in black letter; the argument line below it is in smaller black letter. Verse lines are black letter with long s rendered as s. Some words are doubtful: "d" in "wie d Herr" may be "der" with abbreviation [?]; "schlächtē" and "kaat" are doubtful, as is "frôud" (likely "freud"), and the word after "mit" is partly unclear ("kin" may be "kind"). The top-right number "16" is the page number. Faint show-through text at top left (mirrored from the other side) and the ink stamp at the top were left out. The first line "Lobend" is printed with an enlarged initial L; no separate letter was added.
